Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a single space
                (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code derived from the postcode, the 2-digit fiscal year (the same YY as 'fiscalYear') of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273C70EBD84'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year runs 1 July - 30 June and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (YY is that year's last two digits)."
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when the owner's tenure spans
                more than one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for
                2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but, at the moment it
                was created, shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible duplicate of (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                'true' when any risk signal holds for this owner: it is a possible duplicate
                (possibleDuplicate), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a label
                with a known disposable domain without being exactly blocklisted), or its city
                is over its soft capacity (the approaching-capacity capacityWarning); otherwise
                'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region code of the owner's identity: the REGION prefix of the
                memberId (postcode range first - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099 - then the fixed city table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate against the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record
                is retained and still readable. A newly created owner is 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:

composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: when the request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already recorded for a completed
# create, respond 200 with the originally created owner and skip the whole create pipeline (so no
# duplicate is made and no later quota/duplicate rule fires). Otherwise take the 'proceed' branch to
# run the normal pipeline; the key is recorded against the new owner by the 'register' step below.
idempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  outputs:
    proceed: validate

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing every
# offending field before the body is mapped to an entity.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Reject with 400 when a supplied postcode is malformed (not 4 digits) or out of range for the
# city's region. Absent postcode is accepted (optional). Runs after the required-field validation,
# so the city is known before its region range is applied.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

# Reject with 409 when the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyCreateLimit

# Reject with 429 when 100 or more owners have already been created today (by registrationDate).
checkDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign the deterministic 'householdId' (first 12 hex of SHA-256 over lastName + '|' + postcode),
# so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Still used for the
# household member count and level ceiling; duplicate detection no longer keys off it.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate check: reject with 409 when the new owner's whole identityKey
# (64-hex SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)) equals an existing owner's,
# ignoring soft-deleted owners. This is the single duplicate rule: the former separate
# household-duplicate 409 block no longer applies. Runs before save so the not-yet-saved owner is
# not compared against itself.
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count the owners in this owner's household (sharing 'householdId'), including this
# not-yet-saved owner. Runs after the shared householdId has been assigned and back-filled.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Record how many existing owners share this owner's firstName and lastName
# (case-insensitively), before it is saved so the count excludes it.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

# Assign the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' memberId before saving: REGION from the postcode, FY the
# 2-digit fiscal year of registrationDate, HASH8 = SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)[0:8] upper
# hex, and CHK a Luhn digit over the preceding digits. A stable per-owner identity, so this no longer
# depends on the count of existing owners.
assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Set 'bulkSignupWarning' true when more than 80 owners were already created today (by the
# adjusted business-day registrationDate), before saving so the count excludes this owner.
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Set 'capacityWarning' true when the owner's city already held 40-49 owners (approaching the
# per-city capacity limit of 50), before saving so the count excludes this owner.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match: when the new owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but shares an existing
# owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, still create it and set
# 'possibleDuplicate' true with 'possibleDuplicateOf' the matching owner id; otherwise false.
# Runs after the identity check (so hard duplicates never reach here) and before save.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: register

# Record the request's 'Idempotency-Key' (when present) against the saved owner id, so a later
# repeat with the same key returns this owner instead of creating a duplicate. Runs after save so
# the generated id is available.
register:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RegisterIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, memberId and registrationDate,
# after save so the generated id is available.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notifyWelcome

# Enqueue a welcome notification: emit a NOTIFY log line carrying the owner id and memberId,
# after save so the generated id is available.
notifyWelcome:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. On output this is the
            composed address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized like 'address' (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand
            ST/RD/AVE) and stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or level).
            Normalized like addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth (ISO 8601). When present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a single space
                (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code derived from the postcode, the 2-digit fiscal year (the same YY as 'fiscalYear') of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273C70EBD84'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year runs 1 July - 30 June and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (YY is that year's last two digits)."
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when the owner's tenure spans
                more than one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for
                2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but, at the moment it
                was created, shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible duplicate of (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                'true' when any risk signal holds for this owner: it is a possible duplicate
                (possibleDuplicate), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a label
                with a known disposable domain without being exactly blocklisted), or its city
                is over its soft capacity (the approaching-capacity capacityWarning); otherwise
                'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region code of the owner's identity: the REGION prefix of the
                memberId (postcode range first - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099 - then the fixed city table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate against the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record
                is retained and still readable. A newly created owner is 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. On output this is the
            composed address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized like 'address' (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand
            ST/RD/AVE) and stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or level).
            Normalized like addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth (ISO 8601). When present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a single space
                (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract. Always 2 (identity v2).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year runs 1 July - 30 June and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (YY is that year's last two digits)."
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when the owner's tenure spans
                more than one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for
                2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but, at the moment it
                was created, shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible duplicate of (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                'true' when any risk signal holds for this owner: it is a possible duplicate
                (possibleDuplicate), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a label
                with a known disposable domain without being exactly blocklisted), or its city
                is over its soft capacity (the approaching-capacity capacityWarning); otherwise
                'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region code of the owner's identity: the REGION prefix of the
                memberId (postcode range first - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099 - then the fixed city table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate against the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record
                is retained and still readable. A newly created owner is 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. On output this is the
            composed address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized like 'address' (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand
            ST/RD/AVE) and stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or level).
            Normalized like addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth (ISO 8601). When present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a single space
                (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract. Always 2 (identity v2).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year runs 1 July - 30 June and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (YY is that year's last two digits)."
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when the owner's tenure spans
                more than one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for
                2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but, at the moment it
                was created, shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible duplicate of (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                'true' when any risk signal holds for this owner: it is a possible duplicate
                (possibleDuplicate), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a label
                with a known disposable domain without being exactly blocklisted), or its city
                is over its soft capacity (the approaching-capacity capacityWarning); otherwise
                'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region code of the owner's identity: the REGION prefix of the
                memberId (postcode range first - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099 - then the fixed city table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate against the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record
                is retained and still readable. A newly created owner is 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.

All **70 tests pass** — `BUILD SUCCESS`. The V2 checkpoints (Cp52/53/55/56/57/60) and the region/locality/segment tests (Cp17/30/42/35/46) are all green, along with the rest of the suite.

## What I changed

**Identity derivation — V2 tag mixed in so every identifier changes and no V1 value recurs:**
- `OwnerRegion.java` — added `VERSION_TAG = "V2"` and `identityRegion(owner)` returning the plain region plus the tag (e.g. `NSWV2`). Since it contains a digit, a V2 memberId can never equal a plain-region V1 one. `of(owner)` (plain region) is unchanged.
- `AssignMemberId.java` — the memberId's REGION prefix now uses `OwnerRegion.identityRegion(...)`.
- `AssignHouseholdId.java` — hashes `'V2'|lastName|postcode` (was `lastName|postcode`).
- `OwnerIdentityKey.java` — hashes `'V2'|telephone|email|soundex(lastName)`; equality semantics (duplicate detection) preserved.

**Response shape:**
- `openapi.yml` — removed top-level `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey`; added a nested `OwnerIdentity` schema (those three) referenced as `identity`, plus a top-level integer `apiVersion`. Rewrote the `locality` description.
- `OwnerMapper.java` — maps `identity` (new `identity(owner)` builder) and `apiVersion = 2`; `locality(owner)` now derives the **plain** region directly via `OwnerRegion.of` instead of reading the (now V2-tagged) memberId prefix — so `locality`/`timezone`/owner-segment region stay plain `NSW`. The owner segment is recomputed from that plain region.

**Audit:**
- `AuditOwnerCreated.java` — structured event moved to schema version 2, adding `"schemaVersion":2`; still carries the ownerId and the (now V2) memberId.

The audit logs confirm the split: `memberId=NSWV227786E13D53` (V2 inside the identifier) while `locality` reads back plain `NSW`. Request fields (`OwnerFields`) were untouched.
